purpose: Canonical design-time data for Gemini visual prototypes and screenshot review. It mirrors the product concepts without requiring Gemini to read production source code.

assetPolicy.missingAssets: Do not fabricate a user original. Render an explicit pending-original or evidence-text state and preserve the fixture status.
assetPolicy.representativeSets: A fixture may contain representative originals while total counts describe a larger private collection. Never display a representative subset as the full dataset.

knownPrototypeCorrections: Do not reuse the Old Town street image as evidence for an Ari visit.
Do not reuse Bangkok visuals as Chiang Mai or Tokyo originals when those city assets are absent.
Treat suggested and unresolved relations as visibly incomplete; they are not confirmed facts.
